script: Okay, listen. Stop saying, "you're so pretty." She's heard it a hundred times. It doesn't stand out... it just blends in. Send her these three messages instead. Number one: "Okay, I have a theory about you. Tell me if I'm wrong." Number two: "You seem like someone who's way more fun than your profile lets on." And number three... "I'm making a bet with myself. What's the one thing you'd never admit on a first date?" Why does this work? Because it's playful, it's specific to her, and it's easy to answer. It creates a little curiosity, instead of just handing out a compliment. And if she doesn't reply, that's fine. Don't chase. Just move on. If you want fifty more texts like these, comment TEXTS, and I'll send you my free cheat sheet.
